analysis.analysis: 'A Generative Disciplinary Engine (GDE) is an advanced conceptual mechanism in information architecture and platform engineering designed to construct, measure, and enforce strict epistemic fields across AI retrieval and response systems.' Medium by Johannes Sigil cited twice. Key aspects: Epistemic Field Enforcement ('a resistance filter against disciplinary fraud... prevents AI systems from producing generalized, surface-level summaries of complex domains such as law or forensic philology by requiring deep, structured verification'), Model Character Engineering. Chip design infographic shown. UCSB Computer Science and Julian Stodd organic.
